summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of two static HTML login pages (/cel_bricks.html, /cel_credit.html) at viewport 1920x800. All 8 requested behaviors passed: email validation + clearing, password show/hide toggle, loading overlay on valid submit and blocked on invalid submit (Page 1); plain username & email both accepted with no email-format validation, loading overlay on submit, and full uncut Celcoin logo (Page 2). No backend testing (no auth endpoint exists, per request).
critical_code_review_comments: Static pages have no data-testid attributes; tests relied on ids (#username, #password, #emailError, #loadingOverlay, #ccLoadingOverlay). Adding data-testid would make future automation more robust.
Non-blocking console CSP warnings on /cel_credit.html: Cloudflare beacon.min.js and cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/main.js blocked by script-src policy. No functional impact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified details: PAGE1 /cel_bricks.html - invalid email 'texto-invalido' + blur => #emailError display=block, text 'E-mail inválido', color rgb(239,68,68); valid 'user@celcoin.com' => display=none; .password-toggle cycles #password type password->text->password; submit with invalid email keeps #loadingOverlay display=none and shows error; submit with valid email => #loadingOverlay display=flex with Celcoin SVG logo (naturalWidth 500, rendered 200px) and 'Entrando...'. PAGE2 /cel_credit.html - #username type=text, placeholder 'Usuário ou e-mail'; 'meu_usuario' produced zero visible validation errors and submit showed #ccLoadingOverlay display=flex with 'Entrando...'; email-as-username also worked. Header logo img[alt=Celcoin] renders 158.6x46px with source aspect 3.45 == rendered aspect 3.45 (no clipping; full word 'celcoin' visible in screenshot). A second img[alt=Celcoin] measures 0x0 because it lives inside the hidden overlay - expected, not a bug. Indefinite spinner after submit is expected (no backend).
